items.title: The last withdrawal leaves carry for the next lender
items.description: A new lender collects old SOL after the last withdrawal preserves both carries; the largest complete second-pass trace transfers 1,000 lamports.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS: real owner signatures, market/vault/lender PDA bindings and token CPIs apply. withdraw_in(pool.rs1823-1917) touches, flushes any vest, burns shares and clears only wipe_swept; both carries survive. claim2119-2134 requires positive backed pending/real and caps by lender_sol, all satisfied by the actual swept lamports.
gate_evidence.2: ALLOWS: a safe SPL mint admits T=2*10^18 raw units (<u64MAX), S=1000T=2*10^21 (<u128MAX); B=0 and no lock/epoch record. A1000-lamport realised sweep gives d=0 and each carry=1000WAD. Last withdrawal returns allT and zeroSOL. LastSharesBorrowed at withdraw.rs205-209 passes because B=0. A zero sweep sets the needed trader bit. A1-raw-token deposit mints1000shares; a subsequent1-lamport vested release allocates1001 backed lamports to the new lender. Independent500-lamport and2-lamport traces agree; no imaginary zero-share borrowed state is used.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS: departing lender authorizes its own full withdrawal; the later lender signs only its own deposit/claim and supplies one new lamport. sweep_trader is public. No trusted admin, victim signature forgery, venue trade, minimum-notional override, or unverified account bytes are required.
gate_evidence.4: ALLOWS bounded misallocation: the new cohort receives1000lamports earned/donated before entry in the largest complete pass2 trace. Existing prior raw report already identified this carry inheritance. Magnitude depends on the admitted old share supply; neither profitable repetition nor arbitrary vault drain is established. Score100-15 bounded loss-10 specific high-share empty transition=75.

items.title: Repeated sync calls discard fractional lender credits
items.description: Unsigned syncs discard fractional lender credits; a complete two-release trace loses one lamport, while material aggregate harm remains unproved.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS: SyncLender74-94 binds real lender/owner/market; owner is UncheckedAccount. Unsigned118-132 selects touch_pot and bars rebase writes, which the current-epoch no-forward-chain trace does not need. touch_tail1474-1488 floors interval credits then advances both snapshots.
gate_evidence.2: ALLOWS: two genuine1-raw-token deposits yield1000shares each,S2000. A realised2-lamport sweep over default21600seconds releases1 at midpoint and1 at end via zero sweeps. Each index delta is500000000000000; a victim touch after each credits0, versus1lamport after one final touch. The other lender can receive its own1lamport and the lost value remains tracked.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS: any caller can sync the current-epoch victim without its signature; no rebase or record mutation is required. Unchanged-index syncs are idempotent.
gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: each touch discards less than1lamport per accumulator. The complete source trace proves1lamport; the300-release/100lamport arithmetic lacks a complete live schedule or material economic harm. KI68 discloses current/parked per-touch flooring. No extraction or scalable lockout was established.

items.remediation_limits: Per-lender fractional remainders need share-change/epoch semantics. Copying cumulative-floor differences from the forward-chain path into current touch can select another rounding phase after a share change; no such patch is endorsed.

items.title: Authority changes accept a successor without its signature
items.description: An honest authority change can install unusable governance, pause, or coverage keys; lost governance requires a program upgrade to recover.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS: ApplyConfig canonical loader/version and pending/timelock/expiry checks (apply_config.rs35-81) authenticate the old proposal. ProposeConfig19-25 requires old governance. check_authorities(config.rs769-799) enforces nonzero/distinct roles, not successor control. These are actual constraints, not an outsider authorization bypass.
gate_evidence.2: ALLOWS: a valid Authorities proposal can use the real config PDA as governance, retain a valid writable System-owned fee recipient, and apply within its normal window. The PDA cannot produce the future governance signature through any current signing path. No malformed account or new instruction is assumed.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS honest-admin hazard: the old governance signer makes the address error and fails to cancel before public execution. This is not malicious-admin theft. Pause/coverage successors can similarly become unusable; governance can replace those roles if it remains controlled.
gate_evidence.4: ALLOWS: lost governance prevents later proposals through the current program; retained upgrade authority can repair by program upgrade. User exits remain available. Score100-10 honest-admin precondition-15 upgrade-recoverable impact=75.

require every changed enabled authority to sign

Both semantic ADD-line alternatives are preserved verbatim. All four raw diffs remain in raw_fix_proposals.
items.patch_limits: Option A covers governance only. Option B also covers enabled pause/coverage successors. Both require matching client account metadata; Option A also changes the Anchor account schema/IDL. No compile or integration check.

items.title: Pool vault loads omit token field constraints.
items.description: A future vault importer can admit the wrong asset because the loaders omit checks of the vault mint, authority, and token program.

gate_evidence.1: BLOCKS current substitution: deposit94-99 and sibling vault loads bind InterfaceAccount<TokenAccount> to the stored market vault PDA; create_market281-350 creates that PDA under the intended token program and initializes its mint/market authority. Runtime PDA ownership and current lack of any vault-authority writer prevent attacker replacement. TransferChecked enforces transfer-specific mint/program rules. Missing explicit mint/authority/program constraints remain a hardening LEAD.

items.code_smells: The canonical vault PDA and stored key are checked, but deposit, withdraw, open_short, close_short, liquidate, and expire omit explicit token field constraints.

items.title: Temporary withdrawals change live settlement inputs
items.description: Temporary LP withdrawals alter live settlement legs, but a complete production sequence and loss beyond the documented AIR-20 residual remain unproved.

gate_evidence.1: UNCERTAIN complete execution: arming::inputs208-220 reads real live reserves and259 passes raw l_live to S1/S2; l_spot at223 protects only CR. Accounts and venue identity guards prevent fabricated state. Independent box legs, eligibility, warm-up/freshness, arming gaps, restart markers and persisted EMA updates constrain actual execution.
gate_evidence.2: UNCERTAIN: fee-free quote arithmetic q100,X=Y1000->112 versus proportional200reserves->200 and budget150 changes the live predicate, but the raws do not construct a production-admitted open state satisfying all caps, box and persistence conditions. Same-second calls cannot invent EMA updates; later failure rolls the transaction back.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS conditional actor: an unlocked LP can move its own adopted-venue liquidity and call public settlement; no admin authority is assumed.
gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: both reviewers explicitly identify the accepted AIR20/KI75 residual and no independent borrower loss or net payoff. Source-stated default/alternative-parameter model results are not reproduced measurements from this scan. Altering live legs would change the documented design.

items.known_issue_comparison: AIR-20 / KI-75, source explicitly keeps raw L_live for these legs.
items.code_smells: live reserves feed S1/S2; only the CR leg uses the EMA floor

items.title: Small donations can extend a settlement hold
items.description: Small donations can renew an active settlement hold; sustained blockage and a fix that preserves historical rewards remain unverified.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS conditional mechanism: Deposit130-135 treats nonnegative deposit_hold_until as a marker and requires shared vest_bal==0. SweepTrader uses genuine canonical trader/market accounts and is public; its prologue releases old vest before sweep adds another. pool::vest_in948-999 applies value-weighted floor rounding.
gate_evidence.2: UNCERTAIN complete production setup: all three raws start from S>0 and an active settlement hold; none independently constructs that exact low-value state from open_short through settlement. Conditional arithmetic is valid: with1lamport left and1second remaining, another1lamport sets span10800 at default21600. At the old end, a sweep can release old vest then start a fresh1lamport vest before any successful deposit clears the marker.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS conditional trigger: ordinary donations need no owner/borrower signature. The required normal sweep branch must apply, rather than an after-flush immediate-credit entitlement. Last-share withdrawal flushes vest and successful deposit at zero can clear the marker.
gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: later legitimate income is explicitly protected by the current source and AIR2-04/05 policy. Withdrawals/claims remain available. No guaranteed lasting denial, current profit or safe separate-donation accounting change is proved. The pre-expiry arithmetic does not require winning the exact-expiry race but still requires the initial held state.

items.known_issue_comparison: AIR2-04/05 documentation already states extensions prolong deposits; this low-cost repeated schedule is additional detail. AIR-02 weighted-end rounding is related but a different old defect.
items.code_smells: the shared vest gates deposits; public sweeps renew the vest
items.mechanism_coverage: Preserves both pre-expiry extension and post-expiry renewal before a successful deposit. Simple timestamp-only clearing would reopen historical-income capture, so it is not endorsed.
